Goldman Sachs expects US inflation to be 2.6 per cent in March 2025.

Our baseline is three 25bp cuts in 2025, bringing the funds rate toward 3.6% by year-end.
Jan Hatzius pencils in US unemployment at 4.2 per cent in March 2025.
We pencil in four cuts through 2025, taking the cash rate to 3.10% by December.

Westpac expects Australian unemployment to rise to 4.4 per cent in April 2025.
We expect the RBA to cut the cash rate by 25bp to 3.85% at the May meeting as trimmed-mean inflation returns to the band.
